svg.title: Wireframe chapter 2 (desktop 1280px): Cycling injuries have more than doubled among over-65s.

g.text: The group growing fastest among the injured is older riders.
Cyclists aged 65-74 rose 138% and those aged 75 and over rose 142% (3-year averages,
Per person, the rises were 78% and 92%.
Cyclists aged 65 and over: the biggest rise of any group
Click a cell: its 2011-21 line opens here
darker = bigger % rise; hatched = low count (< 30 a year)
Notes: Working note: % change on 3-year averages, 2011-13 to 2019-21. Cells with an average under 30 a year are hatched as low counts. Source: BITRE.
Older patients stay longer in hospital and are more likely to die
Notes: Working note: all road users, by age band. Admissions and stay 2016-21; deaths in hospital 2011-19. Source: BITRE.
